text.en:
The provisions of Presidential Decree No. 458, as amended, and all other existing laws or
decrees to the contrary notwithstanding, a Manpower Development Service is hereby created in the
Department of Public highways.

This Service shall be headed by a Chief, Manpower Development Service, and an Assistant
Chief, Manpower Development Service, both to be appointed by the President upon recommendation of the

The Manpower Development Service shall have under it, three (3) divisions to be known as; The
Management Development Division, the Training Course Production Division, and the Training Course
Implementation Division, to be headed by a Chief Management Training Supervisor, a Chief Training
Production Supervisor, and a Chief Training Implementation Supervisor, respectively, who shall be appointed
by the Secretary in accordance with the Civil Service Law and Rules;

This Decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
